news.headline: Markets head into a quiet week with the VIX at 2026 lows
news.why: The S&P closed Friday at ~7,786 — just off Thursday's record — for a 3rd straight weekly gain; volatility is near its lowest of the year (VIX ~14.5). Light data ahead until the Fed's Jackson Hole symposium (Aug 27–29), the next big catalyst.

news.headline: Soft retail sales are the one crack in the melt-up
news.why: Friday's 0.6% drop in July retail sales — the biggest in over a year — is the standout weak spot against cool CPI and strong earnings. Energy led the week (+6%), with healthcare and financials also outperforming.

news.headline: Qwen 3.8-27B lands on Ollama for local use

news.headline: Open-weight race heats up: GLM-5.3 also drops
news.why: Z.ai's GLM-5.3 shipped the same day as Qwen 3.8 — capable open models keep arriving weekly, so the edge is picking the right one per task/price rather than any single 'best' model.

news.headline: Ukraine launches hundreds of drones across Russia overnight

news.headline: Massive wildfire burns 27+ sq km in eastern Belgium
